item.text: The mismatch comes from two separate ordering rules: the queue compares priority names alphabetically, while the batch then moves every Beacon shipment ahead of all other accounts. I’m removing the account-specific reorder and making the queue use the defined service ranks, preserving arrival order for equal priorities.
